description:
We are Team VOLTZ7, a fast-moving squad of high school STEM builders from Bengaluru, India. We turn raw NASA satellite data into clean, interactive web tools backed by real statistical analysis.

Our Skills & Interests:

Data & Science: Python pipelines, NASA Earthdata/POWER datasets, and statistical trend testing.

Development: React, JavaScript, interactive charts, and rapid prototyping.

Pitching: Clear visual storytelling and demo production.
summary: Our project, “Be an Earth System Trend Detective,” aims to make Earth observation data easier for everyone to understand and explore. We developed an interactive website where users can select a particular location and discover information about its environmental conditions and trends. Using statistical data and multiple data sources, we created a demo tool that helps common people explore and understand what's happening in different places in a simple and accessible way.
details:
How It Works

Earth Trend Detective turns raw NASA satellite records into a guided, 6-step climate investigation:

  1. Mission Briefing: Jump straight into active environmental case files from the home screen.
  2. Explore Trends: Browse global vital signs. land surface temperature, rainfall, and vegetation health (NDVI), to spot unusual regional shifts.
  3. Select a Case: Pick a real-world environmental alert (like urban heat spikes, shifting monsoons, or forest canopy stress) framed around a clear investigative question.
  4. Investigate Data: Inspect multi-decade time-series charts, spatial maps, and NASA datasets (POWER, MODIS, and GPM).
  5. Analyze Trend: Run built-in statistical checks—including linear regression slopes, anomaly z-scores, and Mann-Kendall tests—to tell real long-term climate trends apart from normal seasonal swings. The Analysis is AI Powered
  6. FUN Challenge: Quiz to make learning fun.
  7. AI Chatbot which has access to Nasa' data to answer questions
  8. Final Verdict: Review statistical confidence levels and real-world ecological impacts, then jump right back in to solve another case.


Tech Stack & Data

  • Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Chart.js / HTML5 Canvas, Python (Deployed on Vercel)
  • Data & Stats: Mainly through API (GeoVanni)
  • NASA Sources: NASA POWER, MODIS (land temperature & NDVI), and GPM precipitation datasets.
